title: The 2021 hot-type symbiotic outburst of YY Herculis: An optical follow-up study
summary: IIA highlighted our optical follow-up of the 2021 outburst of YY Herculis. Observations with the Himalayan Chandra Telescope traced its spectral evolution from 2021 to 2023 and explored how the inferred properties of the hot component vary with orbital phase.
figure_alt: Research figure from the YY Herculis optical follow-up study
figure_caption: YY Herculis study figure. Source: Indian Institute of Astrophysics research highlight.

title: TCP J1822 is a symbiotic star, observations find
summary: Phys.org featured our work on TCP J18224935−2408280. Using optical spectra from the Himalayan Chandra Telescope, we confirmed the system’s symbiotic nature and traced its evolution during outburst.
figure_caption: Light curve of TCP J1822. Credit: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (2023), DOI: 10.1093/mnras/stad3121. Source: Phys.org.

title: Careers in astronomy (in Malayalam)
summary: I joined fellow IIA researchers for a panel discussion and Q&A on education and career paths in astronomy in India, as part of the IIA Talk Series in Indian Languages.

title: Code/Astro 2026 local hub
